page_title: MON 0-2 TOR | Monza v Torino 02/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's the end of the match.
90+3' Torino quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90+3' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball goes out of play. Torino are awarded a corner kick.
90+2' Gaetano Castrovilli (Monza) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
90' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Karol Linetty (Torino) is coming onto the pitch as Eljif Elmas cannot continue after picking up an injury.
89' Saul Coco (Torino) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Antonio Rapuano ignores the protests.
87' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Samuele Vignato (Monza) heads on.
84' Kacper Urbanski (Monza) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
83' Torino are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
80' Yann Karamoh (Torino) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
80' Antonio Rapuano has issued a yellow card to Tomas Palacios (Monza).
79' Paolo Vanoli has decided to substitute Cesare Casadei and he is replaced by Gvidas Gineitis (Torino).
78' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza).
76' It will be a substitution. Gaetano Castrovilli (Monza) is ready to enter the pitch as Keita Balde walks off.
76' Monza fail to score from a corner as Vanja Milinkovic-Savic (Torino) leaps to collect the ball.
76' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. The referee blows his whistle, Monza are awarded a corner kick.
75' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
73' Corner kicks – 0:3.

71' What a wasted opportunity by Patrick Ciurria (Monza)! He creates himself some space inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the left side of the goal, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
70' Alessandro Nesta prepares a substitution. Danilo D'Ambrosio is replaced by Patrick Ciurria (Monza).
70' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Samuele Vignato (Monza) comes onto the pitch so that Kevin Zeroli can be given a rest.
70' Yann Karamoh (Torino) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
69' Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
68' Paolo Vanoli decides to make a substitution. Che Adams will be replaced by Antonio Sanabria (Torino).
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Valentino Lazaro trots off the pitch and is replaced by Yann Karamoh (Torino).
67' Torino show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted. It will be a corner kick for Torino.
66' 0 - 2 Goal! Cesare Casadei (Torino) fires the rebound into the roof of the net after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:2.

63' Torino slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
60' Dany Mota (Monza) serves up a nice cross, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic punches the ball away.
59' Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
58' Keita Balde (Monza) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Antonio Rapuano has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
57' Here is a change. Silvere Ganvoula is going off and Alessandro Nesta gives the last tactical orders to Dany Mota (Monza).
57' Substitution. Samuele Birindelli makes his way off the pitch and Kacper Urbanski (Monza) comes on as his replacement.
56' Kevin Zeroli (Monza) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
55' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 3:11. The shots on goal statistics – 1:6.
53' Che Adams (Torino) takes a brilliant touch after he latches on to a pass on the edge of the box and strikes the ball to the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper dives low and saves his attempt.
53' Pedro Pereira (Monza) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
51' A corner kick by Torino is thwarted by the well prepared Stefano Turati (Monza).

51' Cesare Casadei (Torino) finds himself some space inside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Stefano Turati pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going under the crossbar. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Torino.
50' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Cristiano Biraghi (Torino), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
49' Pedro Pereira (Monza) was too forceful with his tackle and Antonio Rapuano interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Torino earn a free kick.
48' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) sends a cross into the box, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic comes off his line to gather the ball.

48' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Torino) receives a pass and decides to smash the ball from long range, but his poor effort sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monza.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

45+1' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. The referee points to the corner flag and Torino will take a corner.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.

41' 0 - 1 Eljif Elmas (Torino) meets a perfect cross from Valentino Lazaro deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces a strike into the middle of the goal. The score is 0:1.
38' A pass finds the feet of Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) on the edge of the box and he sends in a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's easily gathered by the goalkeeper.
38' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Monza, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
37' Eljif Elmas (Torino) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle for a foul. Monza get a free kick.
36' Armando Izzo (Monza) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.

34' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Torino are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
32' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
30' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) latches onto a cross inside the box but fires a poor effort high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monza.
28' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Antonio Rapuano didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.

27' A pass travels right across the box to Sebastian Walukiewicz (Torino) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper in the middle of the goal, but Stefano Turati denies him with a decent save.
26' Cesare Casadei (Torino) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.
25' Antonio Rapuano interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Valentino Lazaro (Torino).
23' Torino showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession.
20' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Keita Balde (Monza), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The ball is out of play. Monza will take a throw-in.
17' Che Adams (Torino) makes a strong challenge and Antonio Rapuano blows for a foul.
15' Torino seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
12' Stefano Turati makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded by Cesare Casadei (Torino) after a cross from the side.
11' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
9' Stefano Turati (Monza) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

8' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
7' Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle. Alessandro Bianco (Monza) commits a foul after dangerous play. It's a free kick to Torino, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
7' Cesare Casadei (Torino) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Monza will have a goal kick.

4' Che Adams (Torino) makes a yard for himself and goes for goal from long range. It never troubles the goalkeeper as it flies well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monza.
3' Cesare Casadei (Torino) makes a rough challenge and Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Monza in a dangerous position.
2' A cross from Sebastian Walukiewicz (Torino) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Monza will take the kick-off.
Antonio Rapuano is introduced as the referee for today's match.
